sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Neelam Saxena Chandra writes poetry, fiction and children’s stories in Hindi and English. An engineering graduate whose professional background includes Indian Railways, she has developed a literary practice across both languages. Her poetry catalogue includes The Stitched Heart and एक क़दम रौशनी की ओर, collections that reflect her recurring interest in inner strength and renewal.

Her Kabita Live poem ‘Happiness’ follows the changing meanings of pleasure from childhood curiosity through adult ambition to a later awareness of impermanence. In ‘क्या नज़्म लिखूँ तुमपर?’, praise continually exceeds what words can hold: birdsong, moonlight and a river become ways of addressing someone whose presence already seems to be a poem.
